en: A monochrome winter scene showing a snow‑covered building with steep gabled roofs edged with long icicles. The facade has arched windows and a sign indicating it is an inn or restaurant. In front of the building stand several people in winter clothing, one with a sled, next to deep snowdrifts and a wooden fence. Bare trees and a forested hillside blanketed in snow rise behind the structure. At the bottom of the card, printed in red, are the words "Ober-Eichwald i. B." on the left and "Restauration zum Deutschen Hof." on the right.
